hooks.text: 用念动力摆布敌人与环境，主动布置连锁战斗组合
hooks.excerpt: Set up amazing combos placing your enemies in the right spot while using the power of telekinesis at your will!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 虚空赐福、卡牌、碎片、文档与面具组合出每轮不同的构筑
hooks.excerpt: Build up your way with endless combinations of Void Gifts, Cards, Shards, Documents & Masks ! Every run becomes a new experience as you progress through the Void.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 通过角色欲望、书籍秘密与力量命题推进虚空叙事
hooks.excerpt: Get to know each of the characters and their desires, uncover the secrets of the Void through the books, and discover what Power means to you!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
